_notice: Public measure definitions. Contains no personal data.

sbp.label: Systolic blood pressure
sbp.explain: The top number from one blood pressure reading taken at the screening. A single reading can vary from day to day.

bmi.label: Body mass index (BMI)
bmi.explain: Calculated from height and weight. Height and waist can be measured differently between screenings.

rbg.label: Random blood sugar
rbg.explain: A blood sugar reading taken at a random time. How long since you last ate affects this reading.

smoking.label: Smoking
smoking.explain: Your answer to the smoking question.

pain_now.label: Pain right now
pain_now.explain: Your answer to the question about pain at the time of the screening.

chair_stands.label: 30-second chair stand
chair_stands.explain: How many times you stood up and sat down in 30 seconds.

walk_6mw.label: 6-minute walk
walk_6mw.explain: The distance you walked in 6 minutes. Distances are checked for recording errors before they are shown.

phq2.label: Mood screen (PHQ-2)
phq2.explain: A short two-question mood screen. It is a screen, not a diagnosis.
